mentions.name: Salesence
mentions.description: Salesence is an AI-powered platform that helps e-commerce sellers manage, improve, and scale their marketplace operations from a single place, with a focus on time savings and decision clarity. Its current MVP includes a product listing scorecard and analysis, AI-generated product images, and AI product description generation (in final testing), and it is being iterated with real sellers to shape the roadmap.
